positive_snippets: Really comfortable stay! Rooms were clean, and staff were polite. Perfect place for families visiting Gurugram.
Booked for one night during travel. The staff was cooperative, and the process was smooth. Clean property.
negative_snippets:
Dont Book in this hotel, it's a Fake Hotel and in reality no hotel in this name

I booked a stay for 2 days through Agoda and already paid the full amount for the property named “Fab Hotel Atithym”. However, when I reached the property for check-in, the current management informed me that Fab Hotel Atithym is no longer operating there and that the property is now managed under a different name, “Qotel Signature”. They also clearly stated that they are not responsible for my Agoda booking/payment and denied check-in. This means the hotel I booked through Agoda is effectively unavailable at that location.
Guys this Hotel itself not there now its a Bogus , dont book in this hotel and i have faced a trauma on the check in and paid separately for check in at the Qotel Signature. Same Building only but now management changed.
